question: Who among the following won the Vigyan Shri Award 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Srivastava**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rohit Srivastava is the winner of the Vigyan Shri Award 2024.
 
• The Vigyan Shri Award recognizes individuals for their outstanding contributions to the field of science and technology.
 
• Rohit Srivastava's work in biomedical engineering and innovation has garnered significant attention and accolades.
 
• The award ceremony took place in New Delhi, attended by prominent scientists and government officials.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vigyan Shri Award:**

 
 
• The Vigyan Shri Award is a prestigious recognition in the field of science and technology in India.
 
• It aims to honor individuals for their exceptional contributions and innovations.
 
• The award is presented annually by the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Biomedical Engineering:**
 
 
• Biomedical engineering is a multidisciplinary field that applies engineering principles to the medical field.
 
• It involves the design and creation of medical devices, diagnostics, and therapeutic solutions.
 
• Biomedical engineers work on developing technologies such as artificial organs, prosthetics, and medical imaging devices.
 
 
 
• **Innovation in Science and Technology:**
 
 
• Innovation in science and technology refers to the creation of new or improved products, processes, or services.
 
• It drives advancements in various fields including healthcare, information technology, and environmental sciences.
 
• Governments and organizations often recognize and reward innovative contributions to encourage further development.
